probes.question: If svātmamaya = constitutively Bhairava's, who bows? (v1 vs v2)
probes.verdict: GEM + ROUND 2: prakāśa/vimarśa in bhakti grammar — the stotra perpetuates recognition, not describes it

probes.question: How can suffering be acknowledged (v3) AND fear be absolutely absent (v5)?
probes.verdict: RESOLVED: plenitude, not stoicism — fear cannot enter what is pūrṇa

probes.question: If suffering present (v3) and pacification instant (v10), why isn't it gone?
probes.verdict: GEM + ROUND 2: perennial-present — the devotee IS the field of perpetual pacification

probes.question: If mind already His (v1), why need method (v4)?
probes.verdict: RESOLVED: two transformations — grace (immediate, v1) vs practice (gradual, v4)

probes.question: If identity always (v2), why nondifference conditional on hymn (v7)?
probes.verdict: GEM + ROUND 2: v7 is the structural hinge — the hymn converts personal recognition into cosmic instrument

probes.question: What does samayajñam (covenant-knowing) actually grant? (v9)
probes.verdict: PARTIAL: access through covenant not merit; rival (kāla-samaya) unresolved

probes.question: Why does affliction TRIGGER grace rather than block it? (v7)
probes.verdict: GEM + ROUND 2: v3→v4→v7 IS the nanu→āha structure — the stotra performs the IPVV's dialectic in devotional time

probes.question: Why does scripture (v8) replace ritual discipline?
probes.verdict: TEXT SPEAKS: vows/gifts/bathing/austerities CAUSE suffering; scripture's nectar flows without effort

probes.question: Is the colophon's date (v10) historical or mythic?
probes.verdict: STATED + TRADITION: Vasura-saṃvatsara/Pauṣa/kṛṣṇadaśamī; cave-entry tradition separate from the date

probes.question: Why nine verses (padyanavaka) counted when ten are written?
probes.verdict: GEM: colophon counts 9; the opening vyāpta-verse is invocation not verse — the stotra is 9+1, and the 1 is the cosmic frame within which 9 devotional movements occur
